forms.title: Forms
forms.description: Per database: `server` and `options`, each a list of fields - key, label, kind (text, number, select, check), and placeholder, hint, default, choices, min, max, required as they apply. A choice with credentials: false logs in without a user and password. `connect_using`, where a database has one, is the other way to find it than its server settings (a Database node's Connect Using): its `label`, the one `field` sent in their place, the `keeps` fields that still apply, and `credentials: optional` when a user and password only override its own.
